items.title: Porn showing choking or incest to be banned from early November, government says

items.lede: Campaigners welcome legislation which follows recommendations by 2025 review into pornography regulation Pornography that depicts strangulation and incestuous relationships will be banned in England and Wales from early November, the government has announced. The content will be outlawed from 6 November after cross-party pressure prompted ministers to announce new legislation earlier this year. Continue reading...
items.title: Pornography with strangulation and incest to be banned in England and Wales next month
